Blinda is an application for blind and partially sighted users offering streaming of thousands of
audiobooks. Active internet connection is required.

Audiobooks are currently available in German, Slovene and Croatian. The Blinda mobile application
enables users cross-border exchange of all included audiobooks.

Blinda offers an intuitive interface which is accessible both for the blind as well as partially sighted
users. It allows browsing, borrowing and streaming of thousands of audiobooks. It includes an
audiobook player with features such as faster and slower playback speed, search functions, skip and
jump forward and backward functions, place a bookmark, and view chapters.
All audiobooks are arranged into different categories which allow easier navigation and a quicker
search between thousands of titles.
Blind users can navigate the app using Voiceover, while partially sighted users can take
advantage of zoom and increased text size features.
Users can borrow up to 5 audiobooks per day and up to 30 audiobooks per month. Each audiobook
can be borrowed for up to 30 days. The app also offers automatic return of borrowed audiobooks
after expiration.
At the moment, registration is only available to eligible users from Germany, Slovenia and Croatia.
Eligible users are blind and partially sighted individuals from Germany, Slovenia and Croatia, who are
granted access to accessible formats (including audiobooks) in accordance with the Marrakesh treaty
and the national legislation of the user’s country of residence.

All eligible users need to complete the registration process to gain access to the mobile application.
To register visit https://blinda.org/register.

For more information visit https://blinda.org

The Blinda mobile application is funded by the European Union under the Erasmus+ funding
programme.
